notes: Reference date 2018-02-22. All four usable sources carry 'Ops Manual – release date 7/17'; the revision log (2018_03, capture 2018-12-21) shows Release 7/17 as the latest release, so the saved Sections 4, 5 and 8 were in force on the reference date.

What each source holds: 2018_00 (OM Section 8, Employee Benefits) is the governing benefits policy: FMLA (8.1.13), Caregiver Leave for staff and non-continuing faculty (8.1.14), Temporary Parental Leaves for continuing faculty (8.1.15), LTD, statutory disability, and staff leave, sick, STD and personal-day policies. 2018_01 (OM Section 5, Faculty Policies) holds the tenure clock relief (5.5.A.6.b.iii), the pre-tenure period exclusive of leave (5.5.A.6.a-b), sabbatical (5.11.1) and faculty leave of absence (5.11.2). 2018_02 (OM Section 4) holds faculty Salary Continuance (4.2.2). 2018_03 is a revision log only (no policy).

Who is tenure-stream: OM 8.1.15 covers 'faculty with a continuing appointment'; OM 8.2.2's tables place Professor, Associate Professor and Assistant Professor under 'Regular Full Time Faculty Continuing Appointment (9 to 12 month appointment)' and adjunct and visiting faculty under 'Not Continuing'. So 8.1.15 is the tenure-stream member's path and 8.1.14 (staff and non-continuing faculty) is recorded for another group. 'Continuing appointment' is not defined; OM 4.2.1 contrasts 'faculty on continuing appointment' with 'initial year appointees' for salary payment, so a first-year tenure-track member might be read as non-continuing and fall under 8.1.14 (8 or 4 weeks at full pay); the member with two years of service (U8) is on continuing appointment.

Faculty sick pay: OM 4.2.2 Salary Continuance (one month, then the president's case review) is coded as a generic plan (c4, c5). Faculty are excluded from the staff STD (8.3.6, 'Non-Faculty') and from the NY Disability Benefits Law (8.1.1.3). FMLA 8.1.13 says that for an employee's own serious health condition 'the employee must apply for Short Term Disability in conjunction with FMLA', but no STD plan for faculty is saved or described.

OM 4.2.2 salary continuance covers 'illness or other causes beyond the control of the faculty member'; coded as a sick plan (not general_purpose) because OM 8.2.2 describes 4.2.2 as the faculty sick leave policy and U1 excludes sick plans from general purpose.

Not components: sabbatical fellowship (OM 5.11.1; professional development, tenured faculty with six years); tenure-clock extensions for a death (category 4), property loss (category 5), specialized training and administrative duties (5.5.A.6.b.iii second list) — none can be used for a birth; joint-appointment leave review (5.4.F.g, procedure only); staff funeral, jury and military leave.

Cross-references not saved: none needed for the coding. OM 8.1.13 cites 'Fact Sheet 28M(c)', 'Fact Sheets 28M(a)' and '28M(b)', the 'Employee's Guide to the Family and Medical Leave Act' and the 'Employee's Guide to Military Family Leave' (DOL publications; military leave); insurance plan documents on SMARTBEN.com (8.0, 8.1.2-8.1.3, 8.3.6); 'Section II-F of the Clarkson Regulations' (auditing courses); 'Discrimination Grievance Procedures' in Clarkson Regulations (tenure appeals); OM Section 3.1.1.2 (research fringe funding); the FMLA Information Packet. OM 8.1.13 refers to 'Sections 8.3.2.1 and 8.3.3.1 for Maternity Leaves' — after renumbering these are 8.3.3.1 and 8.3.4.1, both saved.

Birth parent's chain (tenure-stream, primary caregiver): paid parental leave 1 semester (c1) with FMLA 12 workweeks concurrent from its start (c2) → discretionary illness extension 12 weeks after FMLA is exhausted (c3); faculty salary continuance 1 month (c4, own illness, generic plan, unlinked to the leave) → president's discretionary continuation (c5).

Non-birth parent's chain (tenure-stream, primary caregiver): paid parental leave 1 semester (c1) with FMLA 12 workweeks concurrent (c2). Both parents need to be the primary caregiver (at least 20 working hours of care a week) for c1; a non-birth parent who is not would have FMLA alone.

Staff and non-continuing faculty chain (recorded, not counted): primary caregiver 8 workweeks at full pay (c13) or secondary 4 workweeks (c14), FMLA concurrent; further FMLA time paid from own balances (c16) or unpaid; all within an optional six-month unpaid leave of absence including caregiver and FMLA time (c15). Administrative, supervisory and general staff: maternity leave without pay after FMLA (c17), normally ending six months from the first day of pregnancy disability.
Calendar: semester calendar, term length not stated; calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order.
